fields.title: 3. Where it touches the judgment layer
fields.md:
| Item | Relationship | Handling | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Probability rules R1~R6 · proposals ①~⑤ | Litigation and regulation are not a condition for any of them | Not triggered · maintained | `state.probability_adjustment_rules` |
| 29 milestones | Not a ruling condition for any of revenue, nameplate GW, operating profit, customer concentration, FAA, or federal contracts | No input | `state.milestones` |
| T16 (frontier AI development suspension suit) | A separate matter with different plaintiffs and claims | No change | `state.triggers_next_12m[T16]` |
| **T18 (new)** | State attorney general suit over Grok image generation | Pending — checkpoint 12/01 · 4Q26 10-K | `state.triggers_next_12m[T18]` |

- **Profit-and-loss path**: There are only two ways numbers could come in. First, if an injunction restricts Grok features or X distribution. In that case the monthly run re-measures the advertising and SI revenue path. Second, if the 4Q26 10-K allocates the provision to this case or states a loss estimate. Until either arrives, it is not put into milestones or probabilities (source: T18 check).
